program:
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (3e-6, 1e-6, 8e-6),      # per-branch PTAT current
    "K":      (10.4, 8.5, 12.0),       # R2/R1
    "gmid_p": (18.0, 14.0, 22.0),      # core PMOS (and OTA load) gm/Id -> low Vsg
    "Lp":     (2.0, 1.0, 6.0),
    "gmid_n": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),      # OTA input pair
    "Ln":     (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "It":     (2e-6, 0.5e-6, 6e-6),    # OTA tail current
    "Cc":     (2e-12, 0.5e-12, 8e-12), # dominant-pole cap vg->vdd
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 8
    I = p["I"]; K = p["K"]; It = p["It"]
    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I
    R2 = K * R1
    veb1 = 0.735 + UT * math.log(I / 10e-6)
    ptat = K * UT * math.log(N)
    vref = veb1 + ptat

    # core PMOS mirror, drains both at ~vref -> matched Vds; low Vsg to lift vg
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=VDD - vref)
    vg = VDD - mp.vgs
    # OTA NMOS pair, CM ~ vref, body effect included
    vtail_est = 0.5
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], It / 2, vds=max(vg - vtail_est, 0.15), vsb=vtail_est)
    vtail = vref - mn.vgs
    ml = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=mp.vgs)
    mnb = lut.size("n", 12.0, 2.0, I, vds=0.7)
    mt = lut.size("n", 12.0, 2.0, It, vds=max(vtail, 0.2))

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # core
    n.dev("M3", "vref", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "b", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2A", "vref", "ea", R2)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "ea", m=1)
    n.R("R2B", "b", "mid", R2)
    n.R("R1", "mid", "eb", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "eb", m=N)
    # OTA
    n.dev("MA", "vg", "vref", "tail", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("MB", "d", "b", "tail", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("ML1", "d", "d", "vdd", "vdd", ml)
    n.dev("ML2", "vg", "d", "vdd", "vdd", ml)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "nb", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # self-bias of OTA tail from core
    n.dev("M6", "nb", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MNB", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.C("CC", "vg", "vdd", p["Cc"])
    # start-up
    n.M("MSP", "st", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MSN", "st", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MS1", "vg", "st", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 0.5)

    # Predictions
    dveb = (veb1 - 1.2) / 300.0 - 0.25e-3
    dptat = ptat / 300.15
    resid = abs(dveb + dptat)
    curv = 2.5e-3
    tc = (resid * 165 + curv) / vref / 165 * 1e6
    line = 0.003
    itot = 3 * I + It + 0.6e-6
    power = VDD * itot
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": line, "power": power,
               "startup_ok": 1, "psrr_1k": -db(line + 1e-4),
               "vg": vg, "vtail": vtail, "ma_vds": vg - vtail}

events.topology: Op-amp-less PTAT bandgap: PNP 1:8, NMOS level-shift pair, long-L PMOS 3-way mirror, NMOS source-follower PMOS-gate driver, inverter start-up

events.reason: M3 lacks headroom (Veb+Vgs_n with body effect) -> triode at cold/low VDD, causing large TC and line reg. Tie NMOS pair bulks to sources (deep nwell), longer PMOS L, fixed line-reg model in V/V.

ERC: nfet bulks must be vss. Tie M1/M2 bulk to vss and size with vsb=Veb so body effect is modelled. Matching survives because both see equal Vsb. Recover M3 headroom: higher gm/Id on both pairs, shor
The NMOS-on-BJT stack lacks headroom at 1.8 V, which gives the bad TC. M2 and M3 drains track VDD, which gives the 0.14 V/V line regulation. The startup branch never fired. Switch to an OTA-regulated
MA in triode: vg=VDD-Vsg_p=0.585 V is barely above the 0.52 V OTA tail, so loop gain collapses (line reg 0.39 V/V, bad TC). Use shorter, higher-gm/Id core PMOS to cut Vsg to ~0.9 V, raising vg and MA

TC is dominated by excess PTAT: +10% K gives +118% TC, and Vref is high at 1.275 V. A linear estimate puts the PTAT/CTAT balance near K~9.5 (Vref ~1.22 V). Everything else passes, so tune K, with smal
